what: Step 5c fold removes the current pause checkpoint before publish without adding one to the new single driver path
scenario_or_breakage: Today the composed-plan validator block checks .pause-requested before redaction/publish; the plan deletes that block and design-publish.sh proceeds from preconditions to plan-block-write with no pause check, so an operator pause requested after compose can be ignored and the plan can publish anyway
suggested_fix: Keep the existing pause prelude in the new foreground Step 5c publish fence immediately before design-publish.sh, or add an equivalent pre-side-effect pause check inside design-publish.sh before validation/redaction/publish
